pages.title: Chapter Overview
pages.text: Gather Fallen Demon Valley resources, complete the fire-prison route, and prepare for tribulation and ascension.$(br2)This chapter contains 3 authored quest lines. The index describes routes and does not replace server progress.

pages.title: Fallen Demon Token
pages.text: A token grants entry, but entering without fire resistance buys only a grave.

pages.title: Spirit Candle Fruit Contest
pages.text: There is one fruit tree, and its once-per-life fortune is not an infinite trade good.

pages.title: Deity Transformation: Fire-Prison Preparations
pages.text: Balance cold flame, gather limited essence fire, and prepare a unique return-to-yang route before ascension.
